selectedState: Use case:ui-mockup. 依据输入已审局部组件制作两个独立手机Sidebar设计A390/B320，白底浅灰细线8px圆角，正常可读字号。A为Find on canvas侧栏，顶部两个icon tabs（搜索选中、素材库未选）、右上×关闭可达；下方唯一textbox placeholder“Find text on canvas...”为空，下面空白搜索内容，不新增结果计数或搜索按钮。B为素材库侧栏：顶部搜索tab/素材库tab（后者选中）、右上×关闭可达；中央“尚未添加任何项目……”“选中画布上的项目添加到此处，或从下方的公共素材库中导入。”；下方浏览素材库链接与三点本地菜单按钮，菜单已展开且仅一项“打开”。不显示文件选择器、不增导入URL/账户/云同步。两侧栏全部在视口内，限高内部滚动、tab和关闭始终可达；纯局部组件，无DooKnow宿主、目录或底部导航，无设备壳。输入图只三组件内容，A/B需要按手机宽度布局，右侧独立打开菜单合到B作为其锚定popup。

functionalInvariants: Current source and exact sourceContracts are functional authority; style-contract.md and actual ToDoo are style-only authority.
Preserve every field/order/constraint, implemented action, role and guard in sourceContracts. Backend/protocol/identity rules are nonvisual and never become editable fields.
One exact renderer may substitute source text/data/disabled/conditional values; substitutions do not certify that incompatible states coexist or that runtime fit passed.
Full independent main pages remain full frames; dense forms remain complete full large-window frames; other local components do not redraw owner chrome.
No full parent canvas substitutes for explicitly planned vendor child menus, pickers, sidebars, dialogs or properties.
forbiddenAdditions: Brand is DooKnow; ToDoo is an existing app and style reference only.
No invented fields, actions, role hierarchy, authentication gate, password sharing gate, automatic save guarantee or backend expansion.
No real secrets, share capabilities or private data: use fictional legal example content, example.invalid URLs, masked secret fields.
Never render API protocol metadata requestId/hash/cursor/expectedVersion as editable fields unless the actual source UI has that input.
No native OS/browser picker or print-dialog chrome.
No owner account/tree/file/share-management/upload/generate controls in a public guest or standalone export host.
No developer/source/API path or review-note text inside product UI.
Vendor loadScene/saveToActiveFile/export/saveAsImage and independent theme chooser disabled. Keep app-owned guarded exports separate.
No embeddables, populated-library publish/remove, selected-element/crop/group/link panels, unobserved external generation or command palette.

compositionRules.captions: Source/title/role/state are recorded here as metadata; optional external labels never become product UI. Missing outer caption alone is not a functional failure.
compositionRules.legibility: Every field/action/row must remain readable at reference scale. Increase artifact canvas or split this job if necessary; never shrink or delete content to meet a job count.
